speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. To help me understand your symptoms, can you describe the nature and location of your flank pain, and have you noticed any changes in your urination?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you experience any burning sensation, urgency, or frequency when urinating? Also, have you noticed any blood in your urine or cloudy appearance?

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: Did you develop any joint pain, swelling, or abdominal pain after taking the cephalexin? Also, have you noticed any dark or tea-colored urine, which could suggest kidney involvement?

speaker: Patient
text: I do not have nausea, vomiting, or burning with urination. I also have not noticed a major change in urine color.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the history of amoxicillin and cephalexin use followed by fever and flank pain, I suspect acute interstitial nephritis. REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis
